```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| results: hide
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year = 2020,
  state = "TX",
  geometry = TRUE,
  key = "a07e75395383876b8ff28b168b696572a39e0566"
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
    begin = 0.05,
    end = 0.95,
    labels = scales::dollar_format()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by Texas County",
    subtitle = "2020 ACS 5-year estimates",
    fill = "Median household income",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey35"),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "grey35", hjust = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
